description: This Python script implements a Streamlit web application that allows users to upload various document formats, index them using different language models (Gemini, OpenAI, Custom), and interactively query the documents through a chat interface. It includes functions for setting up service contexts, processing documents, and managing session state.

methods.name: gemini_service_context
methods.description: Sets up a service context using the Gemini language model and Google PaLM embedding, then sets it as the global default.

methods.name: openai_service_context
methods.description: Sets up a service context using the OpenAI GPT-3.5 Turbo model and OpenAI embedding, then sets it as the global default.

methods.name: custom_model
methods.description: Sets up a service context combining OpenAI and Google PaLM embeddings, then sets it as the global default.

methods.name: process_documents_for_gemini
methods.description: Indexes documents from a temporary directory using Gemini and returns a query engine.

methods.name: process_documents_for_openai
methods.description: Indexes documents from a temporary directory using OpenAI and returns a query engine.

methods.name: process_documents_for_custom
methods.description: Indexes documents from a temporary directory using a custom model setup and returns a query engine.

methods.name: app
methods.description: Main Streamlit application function that manages file uploads, document indexing, chat interactions, and session state.

search-terms: context setup for Gemini and OpenAI
